text:
Alex: Heads-up — a few folks and I are seeing the eng-sync show twice on our calendars this week. Also the recurring series lost the Zoom link on some invites. Anyone else?

CalendarBot: Calendar update: 1 attendee updated event 'Engineering Sync' series (recurrence changed).

Mira: yep saw double for Tue 9am PST -> 10am EST; maybe DST shift? I accepted one and the other says 'no conferencing'

Sanjay: same here. The invites are weird. I pulled the iCal fragment from one invite, looks like there are two different UID values and one has no conferencing. here's the RRULE from the 'no conferencing' one:
```
DTSTART:20260402T090000
RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU;INTERVAL=1
UID:abc123-oldseries@example.com
```

Alex: thanks — that makes sense. Could be someone fixed the time by creating a new series instead of editing.

James: yep — I can see two series in the organizer view; one older (no conferencing) and one new. That explains duplicate events per attendee.

Li-Chen: ugh that was me — I tried to fix the time for a handful of attendees and accidentally clicked 'create new series' instead of editing. I can delete the old series. Will that cancel everyone's past RSVPs?

Alex: If you delete the old series attendees will get a cancellation and the new invite will show up. That should be fine. Please recreate with the event time zone explicitly set to America/Los_Angeles and enable Zoom conferencing in the event. Also post the new link here so folks can re-accept.

Li-Chen: on it — deleting old series now, recreating as weekly Tue 09:00 PST, adding Zoom.

CalendarBot: Event cancelled: 'Engineering Sync' (old series) — cancelled by Li-Chen.

Li-Chen: done — new series created with Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210. New invites sent. @Mira @Sanjay @James please re-accept when you get a sec.

Mira: accepted, looks good. no duplicate now :thumbsup:

Sanjay: accepted. quick request — can we add a short agenda in the event description (RFC reviews, design quickchecks, triage)? it's been a tad unclear which RFCs are on deck.

Alex: added agenda to the event description and pinned it in #eng-platform. Also added a note about proper event time zone: use the event "Event time zone" field when editing recurrence to avoid clients auto-shifting times.

James: re: recurrence hygiene — maybe we should have a tiny doc for how to update a recurring invite (edit vs recreate) and a checklist: set timezone, enable conferencing, avoid copying events. Ops could enforce default conferencing as Zoom for the eng calendar.

CalendarBot: Policy update requested: set default conferencing to Zoom for workspace calendar 'Engineering' — request submitted to calendar-admins.

Alex: Action items: (1) Li-Chen fixed invites (done); (2) Ops/calendar-admins to follow up on default Zoom + doc for editing recurrence; (3) if you still see a duplicate event, DM me screenshots/timezone settings. Thanks everyone.
